Required service 'dirsrv' is not running
WHY
ipa-healthcheck (ipahealthcheck.meta.services.dirsrv) directly reports: dirsrv:
not running. This is the check's own statement, not an inference. Why the
service is not running is NOT determined by this finding.
EVIDENCE
✓ ipa-healthcheck states this service is not running.
IMPACT
Functions that depend on this service are unavailable or degraded. Other
failures in this report (for example ipa-healthcheck checks that could not
connect) may be consequences.
DO THIS FIRST
Check why the service is not running before starting it.
ipactl status
Safety: SAFE — read-only, no state change.
CONFIDENCE
HIGH: Direct report from ipa-healthcheck's service status check.
LIMITATIONS
Root cause of the outage is not established by this finding alone.
